definition_zh: 气候学家；研究气候的科学家
definition_en: a scientist who studies climates, their patterns and how they change over long periods
core_image: 一个人站在高原站的仪器旁，手里夹着一叠跨越几十年的观测表
scene: 一位研究者长期驻守高原站，整理积雪与气温的观测表。 A climatologist compared fifty winters of snowfall records.
sceneCN: 这里 climatologist 指「研究气候的科学家」（第 1 个义项：气候学家）；句意为一位气候学家比较了五十个冬季的降雪记录。图中可辨识物件：高原气象站、观测表、积雪尺、保温服。

pos.zh: 气候学家（可数名词；复数 climatologists）

senses.title: A climate scientist
senses.definition: a scientist whose subject is climate rather than day-to-day weather
senses.definitionCN: 以气候而非日常天气为研究对象的科学家
senses.example: A climatologist was asked to explain the thirty-year trend.
senses.exampleCN: 一位气候学家被请来解释这三十年的趋势。
senses.why: the person suffix added to the discipline names whoever practises it.
senses.whyCN: 加在学科名上的人物后缀，指从事这门学科的人。

senses.title: An observational climatologist
senses.definition: one who works from long instrument records and station networks
senses.definitionCN: 依靠长期仪器记录与台站网开展工作的研究者
senses.example: An observational climatologist checked the station series for gaps.
senses.exampleCN: 一位观测型气候学家检查了台站序列中的缺测。
senses.why: the branch is named for its method: instruments and networks supply the raw series.
senses.whyCN: 这一支以方法命名：仪器与台站网提供原始序列。

senses.title: A modelling climatologist
senses.definition: one who builds and runs computer models of the climate system
senses.definitionCN: 构建并运行气候系统计算机模式的研究者
senses.example: A modelling climatologist tested how the ocean responds.
senses.exampleCN: 一位建模型气候学家检验了海洋如何响应。
senses.why: the same discipline also works on simulated climates, so its practitioners split by method.
senses.whyCN: 同一学科也处理模拟气候，于是从业者按方法分工。

senses.title: A paleoclimatologist
senses.definition: one who reconstructs climates from ice, sediment, rings and old documents
senses.definitionCN: 从冰芯、沉积、年轮与旧文献重建气候的研究者
senses.example: A paleoclimatologist dated the cold spell from lake mud.
senses.exampleCN: 一位古气候学家依据湖底淤泥确定了这次寒冷期的年代。
senses.why: climates older than instruments need proxies, and a specialist grew up around those proxies.
senses.whyCN: 比仪器更古老的气候需要替代指标，围绕这些指标就长出一类专家。

senses.title: A regional specialist
senses.definition: one whose expertise is the climate of a particular region
senses.definitionCN: 专门研究某一地区气候的研究者
senses.example: A regional climatologist knows the monsoon's local timing.
senses.exampleCN: 一位区域气候学家熟悉季风在当地的时序。
senses.why: monsoon timing differs from valley to valley, so local knowledge became its own expertise.
senses.whyCN: 季风时序各地不同，因此地方知识本身成了专长。

senses.title: An applied climatologist
senses.definition: one who turns climate knowledge into advice for farming, building or health
senses.definitionCN: 把气候知识转化为农业、建筑或健康建议的研究者
senses.example: An applied climatologist advised the city on heat planning.
senses.exampleCN: 一位应用气候学家就城市高温规划提供建议。
senses.why: users need decisions rather than papers, and the role is named for that translation.
senses.whyCN: 使用者需要决定而非论文，这个角色就因这种转化而得名。

senses.title: A climate services adviser
senses.definition: one who works in an agency producing outlooks and climate services for government or industry
senses.definitionCN: 在机构中为政府或行业制作气候展望与服务的研究者
senses.example: The agency's climatologist briefed the water authority.
senses.exampleCN: 该机构的气候学家向水务部门做了简报。
senses.why: climate knowledge reaches decisions through agencies, and the title follows the service it provides.
senses.whyCN: 气候知识通过机构抵达决策，头衔就随所供的服务而来。

senses.title: A teacher or communicator
senses.titleCN: 气候学的教师与解说者
senses.definition: one who teaches climatology or explains it to the public
senses.definitionCN: 教授气候学或向公众解释气候学的人
senses.example: The climatologist's column made the jet stream readable.
senses.exampleCN: 这位气候学家的专栏把急流讲得通俗易懂。
senses.why: a discipline also lives through teaching and explanation, so the same title covers that work.
senses.whyCN: 学科也靠教学与解释存活，因此同一头衔也涵盖这项工作。

intro.en: Climatologist joins climatology with the Greek-derived person suffix -ist. The word is a nineteenth-century scientific formation. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: climatologist 由 climatology 加希腊来源的人物后缀 -ist 构成，是十九世纪的科学构词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Greek klima 'slope, zone' gave Latin clima and English climate.
items.cn: 希腊 klima「斜坡、地带」给出拉丁 clima 与英语 climate。

items.en: The suffix for 'study' comes from logos 'word, reason', through Latin -logia.
items.cn: 表示「研究」的后缀出自 logos「言词、理性」，经拉丁 -logia 传入。

items.en: Greek -istēs named a person who does something; Latin -ista and French -iste carried it into English -ist.
items.cn: 希腊 -istēs 指从事某事的人；拉丁 -ista 与法语 -iste 把它带入英语的 -ist。

items.en: Climatology appears in the nineteenth century, and climatologist follows as the name of its practitioner.
items.cn: 气候学在十九世纪出现，气候学家这一称呼随之而来，指从事该学科的人。

items.en: In the twentieth century the role split into observational, modelling, regional and applied posts, and climate services gave it a public face.
items.cn: 二十世纪这一角色分成观测、建模、区域与应用等岗位，气候服务又给它一张面向公众的脸。

items.en: First English date approximate: no exact first use of climatologist is recorded, and it is usually dated to the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 首见年代为约数：climatologist 的确切首见英语书证未被记录，通常定在十九世纪。

note.en: Group one holds neighbouring job titles that share the ending or the field but differ in scope; group two holds real alternatives for a climate specialist.
note.cn: 第一组是结尾相同或领域相邻、但范围不同的职称；第二组才是气候专家的真正替代说法。

entries.definition: The adjective of the discipline, not a person; it describes data, averages and services.
entries.definitionCN: 学科的形容词，不指人；它描述数据、平均值与服务。

entries.definition: A specialist in ancient climates only, one branch rather than the whole discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 只研究古代气候的专家，属一个分支而非整个学科。

entries.definition: A specialist in weather and forecasting over hours and days, not in multi-decade climate.
entries.definitionCN: 研究以小时和天计的天气与预报的专家，而非数十年尺度的气候。

entries.definition: A rarely used feminine form built on the Spanish and Italian pattern; standard English uses the same form for both sexes.
entries.definitionCN: 按西班牙语与意大利语模式构成的罕见阴性形式；标准英语男女同形。

entries.definition: The everyday and policy term for the same profession; it avoids the rarer discipline name.
entries.definitionCN: 同一职业的日常与政策用语，避免了较少见的学科名。

entries.definition: The weather counterpart; the two often work in the same agency but on different timescales.
entries.definitionCN: 天气方面的对应职业；两者常在同一机构工作，但时间尺度不同。

entries.definition: A broader title covering chemistry, physics and dynamics of the atmosphere.
entries.definitionCN: 更宽泛的头衔，涵盖大气的化学、物理与动力学。

entries.definition: A specialist in places and surfaces, for whom climate is one subject among many.
entries.definitionCN: 研究地方与地表的专家，气候只是其众多主题之一。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real word parts, real fixed phrases and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: climatology plus -ist: the person who practises the discipline.
normal.cn: climatology 加 -ist：从事这门学科的人。

normal.en: The family runs climatology, climatologist, climatological, paleoclimatologist.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 climatology、climatologist、climatological、paleoclimatologist。

normal.en: The job title marks its timescale: a climatologist counts decades, a meteorologist counts days.
normal.cn: 这个职称标出时间尺度：气候学家数十年，气象学家数天。

normal.en: Agency posts add adjectives: observational, modelling, regional, applied.
normal.cn: 机构岗位加形容词：观测型、建模型、区域、应用。

normal.en: Climate services put the specialist in front of water boards and city planners.
normal.cn: 气候服务把这类专家带到水务部门与城市规划者面前。

abstract.en: Picture a person holding a stack of tables that covers more years than their own life.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人抱着一叠比自己一生还长的观测表。

abstract.en: Picture a single station on a high plateau, visited every morning for forty years.
abstract.cn: 想象高原上一座台站，四十年来每天早上都有人到访。

abstract.en: Picture a model on a screen beside a real valley, both showing the same slow curve.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上的模式与真实山谷并排，显示同一条缓慢曲线。

examples.en: The climatologist compared snowfall records across five decades.
examples.cn: 这位气候学家比较了跨越五十年的降雪记录。

examples.en: A climatologist warned that one wet year proves little.
examples.cn: 一位气候学家提醒说，单独一个湿润年份说明不了什么。

examples.en: The team hired a climatologist to review the long-range outlook.
examples.cn: 团队聘请了一位气候学家来审阅长期展望。

dict_mnemonic.text: climate 是气候，-logy 是学科，-ist 是从业者：研究气候的人就是气候学家，他看的是几十年的表，不是明天的云

root: 希腊 klima「斜坡、地带」→ 拉丁 clima → climate → climatology（加 -logia「研究」）→ climatologist（加希腊 -istēs，经拉丁 -ista 的人物后缀）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one practitioner outward: the general title, then observation, modelling, ancient climates, regional expertise, applied advice, climate services and teaching.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一位从业者向外展开：先是总称，再是观测、建模、古气候、区域专长、应用建议、气候服务与教学。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one person at a high station holding decades of tables.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在高原台站，手里拿着几十年的观测表。

branches.en: THE TITLE: the person suffix turns the discipline into a profession.
branches.cn: 头衔：人物后缀把学科变成一个职业。

branches.en: TWO METHODS: one reads instruments, the other runs models.
branches.cn: 两种方法：一种读仪器，一种跑模式。

branches.en: DEEP TIME: the same craft applied to climates before records began.
branches.cn: 深时：同一手艺用于记录开始之前的气候。

branches.en: PLACE AND PRACTICE: regional knowledge turned into advice for growers and builders.
branches.cn: 地方与实践：区域知识转化为给种植者与建筑者的建议。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC FACE: outlooks for agencies, and explanation for everyone else.
branches.cn: 公众面孔：为机构做展望，也为其他人做解释。

intro.en: Climatologist is a stack of three pieces: the noun climate, the suffix for a field of study, and the suffix for a person.
intro.cn: climatologist 由三层叠成：名词 climate、表示研究领域的后缀，以及表示人的后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin clima supplies the base, Greek -logia the field, and Greek -istēs through Latin -ista the person.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 clima 提供基底，希腊 -logia 提供领域，希腊 -istēs 经拉丁 -ista 提供人物后缀。

items.example: The base word names a zone.
It marks a field of knowledge.
It turns a field into a job title.

items.exampleCN: 一位气候学家审阅了展望。
一位古气候学家解读了沉积。
气象学家预报了这场风暴。

definition_zh: 齿槽的；肺泡的；（语音）齿龈音的；齿龈音
definition_en: relating to the tooth sockets, the air sacs of the lungs, or a sound made with the tongue near the ridge behind the upper teeth
core_image: 身体里一排排盛着牙、盛着气的小凹槽
scene: 牙科诊室里医生指着片子向病人讲解。 The dentist said the tooth was firmly set in its alveolar socket.
sceneCN: 这里的 alveolar 是「齿槽的」（第 1 个义项：与牙槽相关的）；句意是牙医说这颗牙牢牢长在牙槽窝里。

pos.zh: 齿槽的；肺泡的；齿龈音的
齿龈音

derivatives.zh: 由同一名词单数而来，义为「小凹槽；牙槽；肺泡」
alveolus 的复数形式，常指肺泡
由 alveolus 加形容词后缀构成，义为「蜂窝状的」

senses.title: Relating to the sockets of the teeth
senses.definition: of or connected with the bony socket in the jaw that holds a tooth
senses.definitionCN: 与下颌中容纳牙齿的骨质牙槽相关的
senses.example: Gum disease can damage the alveolar bone that supports the teeth.
senses.exampleCN: 牙龈疾病会破坏支撑牙齿的牙槽骨。
senses.why: The word names the little hollow in the jaw where each tooth sits, so dentistry uses it for everything around that socket.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本义指颌骨上容纳牙齿的小凹窝，牙科因此用它指代牙槽周围的一切结构。

senses.title: Relating to the air sacs of the lungs
senses.titleCN: 肺泡的：与肺部气囊相关
senses.definition: of or connected with the tiny air sacs in the lungs where gas exchange happens
senses.definitionCN: 与肺中进行气体交换的微小气囊相关的
senses.example: Oxygen passes from the alveolar sacs into the blood.
senses.exampleCN: 氧气从肺泡囊进入血液。
senses.why: The lungs are full of little hollows, and the same word for a small cavity was applied to them.
senses.whyCN: 肺里布满小空腔，表示「小凹窝」的同一个词便被借用来称呼它们。

senses.title: Made with the tongue at the ridge behind the upper teeth
senses.titleCN: 齿龈音的：舌抵上齿龈发出的
senses.definition: in phonetics, describing a sound produced with the tongue touching or near the ridge behind the upper front teeth
senses.definitionCN: 语音学中指舌尖抵住或接近上齿龈嵴发出的音
senses.example: The English t and d are alveolar stops.
senses.exampleCN: 英语的 t 和 d 是齿龈塞音。
senses.why: The ridge behind the teeth is the bony alveolar ridge, so sounds made there took the same name.
senses.whyCN: 牙齿后方的骨嵴就叫牙槽嵴，在该处发出的音便沿用了同一个名称。

senses.title: An alveolar speech sound as a noun
senses.definition: a speech sound, such as t, d, n, or s, produced at the alveolar ridge
senses.definitionCN: 在齿龈嵴处发出的语音，如 t、d、n、s
senses.example: This dialect drops the final alveolar in many words.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方言在许多词里丢掉末尾的齿龈音。
senses.why: Once the adjective named the place of articulation, it was turned into a noun for any sound made there.
senses.whyCN: 形容词命名了发音部位之后，它又转为名词，指在该部位发出的任何音。

senses.title: Relating to the alveolar bone tissue
senses.definition: of the specialized bone of the jaws that anchors the teeth
senses.definitionCN: 指颌骨中锚定牙齿的特殊骨质
senses.example: Implants fuse with the alveolar tissue over several months.
senses.exampleCN: 种植体在几个月内与牙槽组织融合。
senses.why: Because the socket is bone, the adjective extends to the bone substance itself.
senses.whyCN: 牙槽本身就是骨质，形容词因此扩展到骨质本身。

senses.title: Shaped like or relating to small glandular pockets
senses.titleCN: 腺泡状的：指小囊状腺体
senses.definition: in anatomy, describing glands composed of small sac-like cavities
senses.definitionCN: 解剖学中形容由小囊状空腔构成的腺体
senses.example: The salivary gland contains alveolar structures that store secretion.
senses.exampleCN: 唾液腺中含有储存分泌物的腺泡状结构。
senses.why: Any cluster of tiny cavities in the body recalls the original hollow, so the word spreads to gland anatomy.
senses.whyCN: 体内任何小腔室簇都让人想起最初的「小凹窝」，这个词便扩展到腺体解剖。

senses.title: Relating to gas pressure inside the lungs
senses.definition: of the pressure or gas measured within the pulmonary air sacs
senses.definitionCN: 指在肺部气囊内测得的气压或气体
senses.example: Alveolar pressure falls as the chest expands during inhalation.
senses.exampleCN: 吸气时胸廓扩张，肺泡内压下降。
senses.why: Physiology measures what happens inside the air sacs, and the adjective follows the location.
senses.whyCN: 生理学要测量气囊内部发生的变化，形容词便随部位一起被使用。

senses.title: Relating to small hollows in general
senses.definition: describing any small cavity or pitted structure, especially in scientific description
senses.definitionCN: 形容任何小空腔或蜂窝状结构，尤用于科学描述
senses.example: The fossil bone shows an alveolar surface under the microscope.
senses.exampleCN: 显微镜下，这块化石骨呈现蜂窝状的表面。
senses.why: Back to the root meaning, anything pitted with little hollows can be called by this word.
senses.whyCN: 回到词根本义，凡是布满小凹窝的结构都可以用这个词形容。

intro.en: Alveolar comes from Latin alveolus, a diminutive of alveus meaning hollow or small cavity, later specialized in anatomy and phonetics.
intro.cn: alveolar 源自拉丁语 alveolus，它是 alveus（凹陷、腹腔）的指小形式，后专门用于解剖学和语音学。

items.en: A root meaning hollow or container, generally reconstructed for alveus.
items.cn: 一般认为 alveus 来自表示「凹陷、容器」的重构词根。

items.en: alveus, "hollow, belly, bed of a river".
items.cn: 拉丁语 alveus「凹陷；腹腔；河床」。

items.en: alveolus, "a little hollow", used for small pits and cavities.
items.cn: 拉丁语指小形式 alveolus「小凹窝」，用于指小坑与空腔。

items.en: alveolaris, formed in anatomical writing for the tooth sockets.
items.cn: 新拉丁语 alveolaris，在解剖学文献中用于指牙槽。

items.en: English alveolar appears in anatomy for tooth sockets and lung sacs.
items.cn: 十八世纪英语 alveolar 进入解剖学，指牙槽和肺泡。

items.en: Phonetics later borrowed it for sounds made at the alveolar ridge.
items.cn: 语音学随后借它指在齿龈嵴处发出的音。

note.en: Distinguish alveolar from its parent word alveolus and from look-alike words that share only the al- spelling.
note.cn: 要把 alveolar 与母词 alveolus 区分开，也要与只是拼写相近的 al- 开头词区分。

entries.definition: the parent noun: a small cavity, especially a tooth socket or lung air sac.
entries.definitionCN: 母词：小凹窝，尤指牙槽或肺泡。

entries.definition: an entirely different Arabic-derived word that merely begins with al-.
entries.definitionCN: 词源完全不同的阿拉伯语借词，只是同样以 al- 开头，形近而已。

entries.definition: the plural of alveolus, the standard term for the lung air sacs.
entries.definitionCN: alveolus 的复数，是「肺泡」的标准说法。

entries.definition: relating to the teeth themselves rather than their sockets.
entries.definitionCN: 指牙齿本身，而非容纳牙齿的牙槽。

entries.definition: a phonetic term for sounds made at the hard palate, near but behind the alveolar ridge.
entries.definitionCN: 语音学术语，指在上腭发出的音，位置在齿龈嵴之后。

entries.definition: relating to the lungs as a whole, of which the alveoli are part.
entries.definitionCN: 指整个肺，肺泡只是肺的一部分。

normalIntro.en: Remember alveolar through its root idea of a little hollow.
normalIntro.cn: 通过「小凹窝」这个词根意象记住 alveolar。

normal.en: alveus (hollow) + -olus (little) + -ar (of): of the little hollows.
normal.cn: alveus（凹陷）+ -olus（小）+ -ar（……的）：属于小凹窝的。

normal.en: Each tooth sits in its own little hollow: the alveolar socket.
normal.cn: 每颗牙都坐在自己的小凹窝里：牙槽窝。

normal.en: The lungs look like bunches of tiny hollow grapes: alveoli.
normal.cn: 肺像一串串小空心葡萄：肺泡。

normal.en: Say t or d: your tongue touches the bony ridge, the alveolar ridge.
normal.cn: 发 t 或 d 时，舌尖正抵着那道骨嵴——齿龈嵴。

normal.en: Family chain: alveus → alveolus → alveolar, from hollow to little hollow to adjective.
normal.cn: 词族链：alveus → alveolus → alveolar，从凹窝到小凹窝再到形容词。

abstract.en: Picture an egg carton: every tooth rests in one dimple.
abstract.cn: 想象一个蛋托：每颗牙都安放在一个小凹槽里。

abstract.en: Imagine thousands of tiny bubbles inside the lungs filling with air.
abstract.cn: 想象肺里成千上万个微小的气泡正被空气充满。

abstract.en: Feel your tongue tap the ridge just behind your top teeth.
abstract.cn: 感觉舌尖轻叩上门牙后方的骨嵴。

examples.en: Smoking destroys the delicate alveolar walls of the lungs.
examples.cn: 吸烟会破坏肺部脆弱的肺泡壁。

examples.en: The s sound is a voiceless alveolar fricative.

sensesIntro.en: From the basic idea of a little hollow, the senses spread to tooth sockets, lung sacs, the speech ridge, and the sounds made there.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「小凹窝」这一基本意象出发，义项扩展到牙槽、肺泡、齿龈嵴以及在该处发出的语音。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of little hollows holding teeth or air
core.cn: 核心意象：一排排盛着牙或盛着气的小凹窝

branches.en: The socket of a tooth in the jaw.
branches.cn: 颌骨中容纳牙齿的牙槽。

branches.en: The air sacs of the lungs and what is measured inside them.
branches.cn: 肺部气囊及其内部测得的气压。

branches.en: The ridge behind the teeth as a place of articulation.

branches.cn: 在该嵴处发出的任何辅音。

branches.en: Bone tissue, glandular pockets, and small hollows in general.

definition_zh: 确认；证实；确认函；坚振礼
definition_en: the act of confirming something, a message or document that confirms it, or the religious rite that strengthens a person's faith
core_image: 落下印章：把还悬着的事按实、定住
scene: 这组词中， After the guest paid the deposit, the hotel sent a confirmation with the room number and check-in time.
sceneCN: 这里 confirmation 是「预订确认」（第 5 个义项：预订确认函）；句意：客人付了定金后，酒店寄来一份写有房号和入住时间的确认函。图中可辨识物件：预订确认邮件、房号、入住时间、付款收据。

pos.zh: 确认；证实；确认的行为
确认函；确认书；（宗教）坚振礼

collocations.zh: 确认偏误（只找支持自己看法的证据）

senses.title: The act of making something certain
senses.titleCN: 确认行为：把不确定变为确定
senses.definition: the act of showing that something is true, valid, or definitely arranged
senses.definitionCN: 证明某事为真、有效或已经确定的行为
senses.example: The lab asked for confirmation of the results before publication.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室要求在发表前先确认这些结果。
senses.why: confirmare is con- 'thoroughly' plus firmare 'to make firm', from firmus 'firm'. The suffix -ation turns that act into a noun, so confirmation is literally 'the making-firm' — the act itself, before it names any document.
senses.whyCN: confirmare 是 con-“彻底”加 firmare“使坚固”，后者出自 firmus“坚固”。后缀 -ation 把这个动作变成名词，因此 confirmation 字面上就是“使坚固这件事”——先指行为本身，还不指任何文件。

senses.title: A message that confirms
senses.definition: an email, letter, or message that states that an arrangement is definite
senses.definitionCN: 说明某项安排已经确定的邮件、信件或消息
senses.example: She received a confirmation within minutes of booking the flight.
senses.exampleCN: 她订完机票几分钟后就收到了确认消息。
senses.why: Action nouns in -ation can name the result as well as the act. Once the making-firm is finished, the thing that carries it — the message — is also called a confirmation, because the paper or email now holds the firmness.
senses.whyCN: -ation 类动作名词既能指行为，也能指结果。一旦“使坚固”完成，承载它的东西——那条消息——也被叫作 confirmation，因为纸张或邮件此时替人保存了这份确定。

senses.title: Confirmation bias: the mind proving itself right
senses.titleCN: 确认偏误：只找支持自己的证据
senses.definition: the tendency to notice and trust information that supports what one already believes
senses.definitionCN: 倾向于注意并相信支持自己既有看法的信息
senses.example: Confirmation bias led the team to notice only the data that supported its plan.
senses.exampleCN: 确认偏误让团队只注意到支持自己计划的数据。
senses.why: This 20c psychological term keeps the 'making firm' image but turns it inward: the mind seeks evidence that firms up a belief it already holds. Here confirmation is not a message from outside but an act of self-reinforcement.
senses.whyCN: 这个 20 世纪的心理学词保留了“使坚固”的意象，却把它转向内部：心智去寻找能让既有信念更坚固的证据。这里的 confirmation 不是外来消息，而是一种自我加固的动作。

senses.title: A hearing that confirms an appointment
senses.definition: a formal hearing in which a committee examines a nominee before approving the appointment
senses.definitionCN: 委员会在批准任命前审查被提名者的正式听证会
senses.example: The senate held a confirmation hearing for the new judge.
senses.exampleCN: 参议院为这位新法官举行了确认听证会。
senses.why: In this political branch, 'make firm' is applied to a person's official standing: the nominee is not securely in office until the appointment is confirmed. The hearing is the procedure that produces that firmness.
senses.whyCN: 在这一政治分支里，“使坚固”作用于一个人的官方地位：任命未经确认，被提名者就还没有稳稳地进入职位。听证会就是产生这份确定性的程序。

senses.title: A booking confirmed in writing
senses.definition: a document or message that proves a reservation, ticket, or booking is final
senses.definitionCN: 证明预订、机票或订房已经最终生效的文件或消息
senses.example: Keep your confirmation in case the front desk cannot find the reservation.
senses.exampleCN: 把确认函留着，以防前台找不到这条预订记录。
senses.why: The commercial sense is 20c: a reservation stays provisional until the hotel makes it firm in writing. The document that performs this act then takes the name of the act itself, a common pattern in travel and booking language.
senses.whyCN: 商业义是 20 世纪的产物：预订在酒店以书面方式将其“定实”之前都只是暂定的。完成这一动作的文件于是直接继承了动作的名字，这在旅游和预订用语中很常见。

senses.title: The sacrament that strengthens faith
senses.titleCN: 坚振礼：坚固信仰的圣礼
senses.definition: a religious rite in which a baptized person affirms their faith and is said to receive strength from the Holy Spirit
senses.definitionCN: 受洗者确认自己的信仰、并被认为从圣灵获得力量的宗教仪式
senses.example: In some churches, young people receive confirmation at about thirteen.
senses.exampleCN: 在一些教会里，年轻人十三岁左右接受坚振礼。
senses.why: The religious sense is the oldest in English, recorded in the 13c. Latin firmare also meant 'strengthen', so confirmation became the sacrament that strengthens baptismal faith. The original metaphor of making firm is here applied to a person's belief.
senses.whyCN: 宗教义是英语里最古老的一支，13 世纪已有记录。拉丁语 firmare 同时有“使强壮”之意，因此 confirmation 成了坚固受洗信仰的圣礼。原本“使坚固”的比喻在这里落到了人的信念上。

senses.title: A receipt that confirms payment
senses.titleCN: 收据确认：证明款项已付
senses.definition: a receipt or stamp that officially acknowledges that money has been paid
senses.definitionCN: 正式承认款项已付的收据或印章
senses.example: The cashier stamped the receipt as confirmation of payment.
senses.exampleCN: 收银员在收据上盖章，作为付款确认。
senses.why: Here -ation again names the concrete evidence of an act: the stamped receipt is the making-firm of a payment, proof that the transaction will not be reopened. The thing that fixes the record borrows the name of the fixing.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 -ation 又指动作的具体证据：盖了章的收据就是付款的“使坚固”，是这笔交易不会再有争议的证明。固定记录的那件东西，借用了“固定”这个动作的名字。

senses.title: A test that confirms an earlier result
senses.definition: a second test carried out to check a provisional result from an earlier test
senses.definitionCN: 为检查先前初步结果而进行的第二次测试
senses.example: A confirmatory test was run after the first screen gave a faint line.
senses.exampleCN: 初筛出现浅线后，又做了一次验证性测试。
senses.why: Confirmatory is confirm plus -atory 'serving to'. A confirmatory test is a second act of making firm, ordered precisely because the first result was not yet firm. Confirmation here names that second stage rather than a document.
senses.whyCN: confirmatory 是 confirm 加 -atory“用于……的”。验证性测试就是第二次“使坚固”，之所以要做，正是因为第一次结果还不够牢靠。这里的 confirmation 指那个第二阶段，而不是文件。

senses.title: An official statement by an authority
senses.titleCN: 官方确认：权威机构的正式声明
senses.definition: a public statement from an official body that settles a report or rumour
senses.definitionCN: 官方机构就某报道或传言作出的、使其尘埃落定的公开声明
senses.example: The ministry issued an official confirmation of the outbreak.
senses.exampleCN: 卫生部发布了关于这次疫情的官方确认。
senses.why: An official confirmation is the state's version of making firm: an authority's published word turns a rumour into a settled fact. The noun gains weight from the institution, which is why 'official' so often precedes it.
senses.whyCN: 官方 confirmation 是国家版本的“使坚固”：权威机构公开表态，传言才变成确定的事实。这个名词的分量来自机构本身，所以 official 常与它连用。

intro.en: Confirmation is the Latin verb confirmare fitted with the action-noun suffix -ation. The religious branch is the earliest recorded in English; the commercial booking sense is a 20c addition. Exact first dates differ between dictionaries, so the centuries below are approximate.
intro.cn: confirmation 是拉丁动词 confirmare 加上动作名词后缀 -ation 构成的。英语中最早记录的是宗教分支；商业预订义则是 20 世纪的增补。各家词典标注的首见年代并不一致，下面几个世纪均为大致估计。

items.en: The base is firmus 'firm, solid', which produced the verb firmare 'to make firm, strengthen'. The prefix con- 'together, thoroughly' intensifies it into confirmare 'to strengthen, establish, ratify'.
items.cn: 底层是 firmus“坚固的、结实的”，由此产生动词 firmare“使坚固、使强壮”。前缀 con-“一起、彻底”加强它，构成 confirmare“加固、确立、批准”。

items.en: Latin turned the verb into the action noun confirmatio (stem confirmation-), built with -atio. English borrowed this pattern as -ation, which names both the act of making firm and, later, the thing that records it.
items.cn: 拉丁语用 -atio 把动词变成动作名词 confirmatio（词干 confirmation-）。英语以 -ation 接受这一构词模式，它既指“使坚固”的行为，后来又指记录这一行为的东西。

items.en: The religious sense is recorded in English in the 13c: confirmation as the sacrament that strengthens a baptized person's faith. This is the earliest English branch, and it preserves the 'strengthen' side of firmare.
items.cn: 宗教义在 13 世纪已见于英语：confirmation 指坚固受洗者信仰的圣礼。这是英语中最早的分支，它保留了 firmare 的“使强壮”一面。

items.en: From the 14c onward, confirm and confirmation are used for the formal ratification of charters, treaties and appointments. Here 'make firm' becomes a legal act: an authority puts its weight behind an arrangement. Precise dating is approximate.
items.cn: 从 14 世纪起，confirm 与 confirmation 用于对特许状、条约和任命的正式批准。这里“使坚固”变成法律行为：权威为某项安排背书。确切年代只能大致估计。

items.en: The everyday sense 'proof that something is true' broadens in the 17c–19c: confirmation of a report, a theory or a result. The noun now covers evidence as well as the act of producing it.
items.cn: “某事物为真的证据”这一日常义在 17 至 19 世纪扩大：对报道、理论或结果的 confirmation。此时名词既指产生证据的行为，也指证据本身。

items.en: The 20c adds booking and email confirmations, along with confirmation bias and confirmation hearings. The old image survives: each branch fixes something that was still provisional. The exact coinage date of the booking sense is uncertain.
items.cn: 20 世纪又添出预订确认、邮件确认，以及 confirmation bias 和 confirmation hearing。旧意象仍在：每个分支都在把原本暂定的事情定下来。预订义的确切产生年代存疑。

note.en: The first group collects words that look or sound close to confirmation; the second collects words with a nearby meaning. Form is checked before meaning, because the -ation ending is a common trap.
note.cn: 第一组是与 confirmation 形音相近的词；第二组是意思相近的词。先看词形，因为 -ation 词尾是常见的混淆点。

entries.definition: to make something certain, valid, or officially approved. It is the verb behind confirmation, not another noun.
entries.definitionCN: 使某事确定、有效或获正式批准。它是 confirmation 背后的动词，而不是另一个名词。

entries.definition: the arrangement or shape of something, especially a molecule. It also ends in -ation but comes from conformare (con- + forma 'shape'), so it means arrangement, not making firm.
entries.definitionCN: 某物的排列或形状，尤指分子构象。它同样以 -ation 结尾，却来自 conformare（con- + forma“形状”），因此意思是“排列成形”，不是“使坚固”。

entries.definition: a person who is about to receive the religious rite of confirmation. The -and suffix marks someone who is to undergo the action.
entries.definitionCN: 即将接受坚振礼的人。后缀 -and 标记将要经历该动作的人。

entries.definition: the process of checking whether something is true or accurate. It stresses the investigation, while confirmation stresses the settled result.
entries.definitionCN: 核查某事物是否真实或准确的过程。它强调调查过程，而 confirmation 强调已经落定的结果。

entries.definition: the act of proving or officially accepting that something is valid. It often implies a formal test or approval, closer to a technical confirmation.
entries.definitionCN: 证明或正式认可某事物有效的行为。它常含正式检验或批准的意味，更接近技术性的 confirmation。

entries.definition: formal approval of an agreement or appointment, making it legally binding. It is narrower and more legal than confirmation.
entries.definitionCN: 对协议或任命的正式批准，使其具有法律约束力。它比 confirmation 更窄、更偏法律。

entries.definition: evidence that supports a statement or theory. It adds separate proof from another source, while confirmation can be a single act.
entries.definitionCN: 支持某项陈述或理论的证据。它强调来自另一来源的独立佐证，而 confirmation 可以只是一次确认动作。

entries.definition: a positive statement that something is true or that one supports it. It is spoken and personal, whereas confirmation may be documentary or official.
entries.definitionCN: 肯定某事为真或表示支持的正面陈述。它偏口头和个人，而 confirmation 可以是书面或官方的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin pieces con- and firm, the real suffix -ation, and the real derivative family of confirm.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁成分 con- 与 firm、真实的后缀 -ation，以及 confirm 真实的派生词族。

normal.en: The core is firm: confirmare = con- 'thoroughly' + firmare 'make firm'. A confirmation is the act that leaves a fact firm rather than wobbling.
normal.cn: 核心是 firm：confirmare = con-“彻底”+ firmare“使坚固”。confirmation 就是让事实不再摇晃、稳稳立住的那个动作。

normal.en: confirm and affirm share the same firmare base; ad- 'to' gives affirm, while con- 'thoroughly' gives confirm. Both make a statement firm, from different directions.
normal.cn: confirm 与 affirm 共用 firmare 词基：ad-“向”构成 affirm，con-“彻底”构成 confirm。两者都让陈述变坚固，只是方向不同。

normal.en: -ation does double duty: it names the act (the confirmation of a theory) and the artefact (the hotel confirmation). The context decides which one you have.
normal.cn: -ation 有双重职责：既指行为（对理论的 confirmation），也指产物（酒店的确认函）。语境决定你遇到的是哪一个。

normal.en: Confirmation bias is the same 'make firm' turned inward: the mind keeps selecting evidence that firms up what it already believes.
normal.cn: confirmation bias 是同一个“使坚固”转向内部：心智不断挑选能让既有信念更坚固的证据。

normal.en: The religious sense rests on the other meaning of firmare, 'to strengthen': confirmation strengthens baptismal faith, which is why the rite kept the old word.
normal.cn: 宗教义依靠 firmare 的另一层意思“使强壮”：confirmation 坚固受洗的信仰，所以这个仪式沿用了这个老词。

abstract.en: Picture soft wax under a seal: before the press it can still be changed, after it cannot. Confirmation is the press, the seal, and the hardened wax all at once.
abstract.cn: 想象印章下的软蜡：按压之前还能改，按压之后就不能了。confirmation 同时是按压、印章和变硬的蜡。

abstract.en: The same press appears as a lab result, an email, a Senate hearing, a receipt and a sacrament; the material changes, the fixing does not.
abstract.cn: 同一次按压会以实验结果、邮件、参议院听证、收据和圣礼出现；材料变了，固定这件事没变。

abstract.en: A belief that only seeks its own evidence is a seal pressed by the mind on its own wax: the impression is real, but the wax was chosen by the presser.
abstract.cn: 只寻找自身证据的信念，是心智在自己的蜡上按下印章：印痕是真的，但蜡是按压者自己选的。

examples.en: Please send a confirmation once the payment has cleared.
examples.cn: 款项到账后请发一份确认。

examples.en: The senate held a confirmation hearing for the new judge.
examples.cn: 参议院为这位新法官举行了确认听证会。

examples.en: In some churches, young people receive confirmation at about thirteen.
examples.cn: 在一些教会里，年轻人十三岁左右接受坚振礼。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「肯费美申」：肯（con）费（fir）美（ma）申（tion）——肯花力气，把申请审实定案 → confirmation 确认；确认函

root: confirm（con- 加强 + firmare 使坚固，源自 firmus 坚固）+ -ation 名词后缀；核心是“把不牢靠的事变坚固、定下来”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of confirmation, all one gesture: something provisional is pressed into a firm state, whether the thing fixed is a fact, a booking, a belief, an appointment, a payment or a person's faith.
sensesIntro.cn: confirmation 的九个义项都是同一个动作：把暂定之物压成确定状态——被固定住的可以是事实、预订、信念、任命、付款或一个人的信仰。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a seal pressed onto soft wax, turning something provisional into something fixed.
core.cn: 核心意象：印章压在软蜡上，把暂定之物变成固定之物。

branches.en: ACT AND MESSAGE: first the act of making firm, then the message or document that carries the firmness.
branches.cn: 行为与消息：先有“使坚固”的动作，再有承载这份确定性的消息或文件。

branches.en: MIND AND TEST: the same press turned inward, where a belief confirms itself or a second test confirms a first result.
branches.cn: 心智与检验：同一次按压转向内部——信念自我加固，或第二次测试确认第一次的结果。

branches.en: AUTHORITY: a nominee or a report becomes firm only when an institution formally confirms it.
branches.cn: 权威：被提名者或报道只有在机构正式确认后才变得确定。

branches.en: COMMERCE: bookings and payments are fixed in writing, and the written proof inherits the name of the act.
branches.cn: 商业：预订与付款靠书面固定下来，书面凭证继承了动作的名字。

branches.en: SACRAMENT: firmare as 'strengthen' becomes the rite that strengthens a person's faith.
branches.cn: 圣礼：firmare 的“使强壮”化为坚固个人信仰的仪式。

intro.en: Confirmation is one of the most transparent -ation nouns: confirm is a living English verb, and -ation is a living suffix that turns it into an act or its result. The word is not a single opaque borrowing.
intro.cn: confirmation 是最透明的 -ation 名词之一：confirm 是活的英语动词，-ation 是活的后缀，把它变成行为或行为的结果。它不是一整块不可拆的借词。

latinIntro.en: Latin confirmare 'to strengthen, establish' is built from con- and firmare, and its action noun confirmatio supplies the -ation pattern. The same firmus base gives firm, firmness and affirm, so the family is wider than the confirm- words alone.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 confirmare“加固、确立”由 con- 与 firmare 构成，其动作名词 confirmatio 提供了 -ation 模式。同一个 firmus 词基还给出 firm、firmness、affirm，因此这个词族比 confirm- 系列更宽。

items.meaning: to make something certain or officially valid
items.meaningCN: 确认；证实；批准（con- 表“彻底”，firm 表“使坚固”）
items.example: The airline confirmed the new departure time by email.
items.exampleCN: 航空公司通过邮件确认了新的起飞时间。

items.meaning: the act of confirming, or the message that confirms
items.meaningCN: 确认；确认函（-ation 构成行为或结果名词）
items.example: The confirmation arrived before we reached the airport.
items.exampleCN: 我们到机场之前确认函就到了。

items.meaningCN: 已确认的；根深蒂固的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.example: The confirmed cases rose sharply that week.
items.exampleCN: 那一周确诊病例数急剧上升。

items.meaning: the act of confirming, or something that confirms
items.meaningCN: 确认中的；起确认作用的（-ing 构成现在分词）
items.example: The confirming letter settled the dispute.
items.exampleCN: 那封确认信解决了争议。

items.meaning: serving to confirm an earlier result
items.meaningCN: 验证性的；用于确认的（-atory 表“用于……”）
items.example: A confirmatory scan followed the first X-ray.
items.exampleCN: 第一次 X 光之后又做了一次验证性扫描。

items.meaning: able to be confirmed or verified
items.meaningCN: 可确认的；可证实的（-able 表“能够被……”）
items.example: The claim is confirmable with two independent sources.
items.exampleCN: 这一说法可以用两个独立来源加以确认。

items.meaningCN: 未经确认的（un- 表否定）
items.example: Reports of the closure remain unconfirmed.
items.exampleCN: 关于关闭的报道仍未得到确认。

items.meaning: to confirm again, especially a booking
items.example: Guests must reconfirm their seats two hours before departure.
items.exampleCN: 旅客必须在起飞前两小时再次确认座位。

items.meaning: to show that something is not true
items.meaningCN: 否定；证伪（dis- 表反转或否定）
items.example: The new evidence disconfirmed the earlier theory.
items.exampleCN: 新证据否定了先前的理论。

definition_zh: 渔业；渔场；渔业资源；捕捞与养殖产业；内陆渔业；渔业管理
definition_en: the industries and systems that catch, manage and sometimes farm fish and other aquatic organisms
core_image: 港口里渔船并排靠岸，冰面上摊着不同大小的鱼，拍卖牌不停翻动
scene: 天还没亮，港口已经挤满渔船，拍卖员举着牌子喊出第一筐鱼的价格。 Fisheries across the region agreed to a shared catch limit.
sceneCN: 这里指「捕捞与管理水产品的产业体系」（第 1 个义项：以捕获、养殖与经营鱼类及其他水生物为业的行业整体）；句意为本区域各渔业同意接受一个共享的捕捞上限。场景物件：渔船、鱼筐、冰面、拍卖牌。

pos.zh: 渔业；渔场（fishery 的复数，常作集合名词）

senses.title: The industry as a whole
senses.definition: the industries and systems that catch, manage and sometimes farm fish and other aquatic organisms
senses.definitionCN: 以捕获、管理并有时养殖鱼类及其他水生物为业的产业与体系
senses.example: Fisheries across the region agreed to a shared catch limit.
senses.exampleCN: 本区域各渔业同意接受一个共享的捕捞上限。
senses.why: The plural of fishery can name the whole sector, not just several fishing grounds, because the industry is made of many units.
senses.whyCN: fishery 的复数可指整个行业，而不只是几处渔场，因为产业由许多单元组成。

senses.title: Fishing grounds
senses.definition: the places where commercial fishing takes place
senses.definitionCN: 商业捕捞实际进行的海域或水域
senses.example: The northern fisheries closed after the stock fell.
senses.exampleCN: 资源下降后，北方各渔场关闭了。
senses.why: A fishery is first a place on the water, so the plural can simply mean several grounds.
senses.whyCN: fishery 首先是水面上的一个地点，因此复数可以只指几处渔场。

senses.title: Fleets and operations
senses.definition: the boats, gear and crews that work a stock
senses.definitionCN: 作业于某一资源的船只、渔具与船员
senses.example: Artisanal fisheries use smaller boats than industrial ones.
senses.exampleCN: 手工渔业使用的船比工业渔业小。
senses.why: Management counts capacity, so the word can mean the operating units rather than the fish or the place.
senses.whyCN: 管理要统计产能，因此这个词也可指作业单元，而不是鱼或地点。

senses.title: Fish stocks
senses.definition: the populations of fish that a fishery harvests
senses.definitionCN: 渔业所收获的鱼类种群
senses.example: Shared fisheries require joint stock assessments.
senses.exampleCN: 共享渔业需要联合的资源评估。
senses.why: A fishery is also shorthand for the stock it depends on, because management is written about the two together.
senses.whyCN: fishery 也常简称它所依赖的资源，因为管理文本把两者写在一起。

senses.title: The sector including aquaculture
senses.definition: the wider food sector that includes capture fisheries and fish farming
senses.definitionCN: 包含捕捞渔业与鱼类养殖的更宽食品行业
senses.example: Global fisheries now produce more farmed than wild fish.
senses.exampleCN: 全球渔业如今生产的养殖鱼多于野生鱼。
senses.why: Statistical agencies group capture and culture under one heading, so the plural widened to cover both.
senses.whyCN: 统计机构把捕捞与养殖归在同一标题下，因此复数扩展到两者。

senses.title: Inland fisheries
senses.definition: fisheries in rivers, lakes and reservoirs rather than the sea
senses.definitionCN: 河流、湖泊与水库而非海中的渔业
senses.example: Inland fisheries feed millions of people.
senses.exampleCN: 内陆渔业养活了数百万人。
senses.why: The same activity happens in fresh water, so the plural needed a modifier rather than a new word.
senses.whyCN: 同一活动也发生在淡水中，因此复数只需加修饰语，而不必另造新词。

senses.title: Management and science
senses.definition: the agencies, rules and assessments that regulate fishing
senses.definitionCN: 规范捕捞的机构、规则与评估
senses.example: Fisheries science sets the limit, and fisheries policy enforces it.
senses.exampleCN: 渔业科学设定上限，渔业政策负责执行。
senses.why: Because the word appears constantly in regulation, it can stand for the management system itself.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个词不断出现在法规中，它可以指管理体系本身。

senses.title: Access rights and jurisdiction
senses.definition: the legal rights to fish a stock or in a zone
senses.definitionCN: 在某资源或某区域捕鱼的法定权利
senses.example: The two states share fisheries in the strait.
senses.exampleCN: 两国共享海峡内的渔业权。
senses.why: Law treats the right to fish as a kind of property, so the plural can name those rights.
senses.whyCN: 法律把捕鱼权当作一种财产，因此复数可以指这些权利。

intro.en: Fisheries is the plural of fishery, formed from native fish plus the place-and-practice suffix -ery, which came through French from Latin -aria. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: fisheries 是 fishery 的复数，由本族词 fish 加表示地点与行业的后缀 -ery 构成，后者经法语来自拉丁 -aria。年代均为约数。

items.en: Fisc 'fish' descends from Germanic *fiskaz, a reconstructed form related to Latin piscis.
items.cn: fisc「鱼」出自日耳曼语 *fiskaz，此为重构形式，与拉丁 piscis 同源。

items.en: The suffix -ery came through Old French -erie from Latin -aria, naming a place where something is done or a collective practice.
items.cn: 后缀 -ery 经古法语 -erie 来自拉丁 -aria，命名做事的地点或集合性的行业。

items.en: Fishery first named a place for catching fish, then the business carried on there.
items.cn: fishery 最初指捕鱼的地点，随后指在那里进行的生意。

items.en: The plural fisheries widened from several grounds to the whole industry and its management systems.
items.cn: 复数 fisheries 从几处渔场扩展到整个产业及其管理体系。

items.en: Twentieth-century statistics extended fisheries to include aquaculture and inland capture, making it a sector term.
items.cn: 二十世纪统计把水产养殖与内陆捕捞纳入 fisheries，使其成为行业术语。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Germanic source of *fiskaz is not settled, and the first use of fisheries as a sector term is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：*fiskaz 在日耳曼语之前的来源无定论，fisheries 作为行业术语的最早使用没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds singular, plural and personal forms of the same fish family; group two holds neighbouring food-sector and management terms.
note.cn: 第一组是同一 fish 词族的单数、复数与人物形式；第二组是邻近的食品行业与管理术语。

entries.definition: One ground, stock or business; fisheries can mean several of them or the whole sector.
entries.definitionCN: 一处渔场、一份资源或一家企业；fisheries 可指数个，也可指整个行业。

entries.definition: A person who fishes or a fishing vessel; it is an agent, not the industry.
entries.definitionCN: 捕鱼的人或渔船；它是施事者，不是行业。

entries.definition: The act or sport of catching fish; fisheries is the organized industry and its management.
entries.definitionCN: 捕鱼的行为或运动；fisheries 是有组织的产业及其管理。

entries.definition: The animal itself; the plural fisheries names the human system built around catching it.
entries.definitionCN: 动物本身；fisheries 指围绕捕捉它建立的人类体系。

entries.definition: The farming of aquatic organisms; it is included in the broad sector but is not capture fishing.
entries.definitionCN: 水生物的养殖；它被纳入宽口径行业，但不是捕捞。

entries.definition: A population of fish treated as a harvestable unit; fisheries depend on stocks but are not the stocks.
entries.definitionCN: 被当作可收获取单元的鱼类种群；渔业依赖资源，但不等同于资源。

entries.definition: The fish actually taken; it is the output of a fishery, not the system.
entries.definitionCN: 实际捕到的鱼；它是渔业的产出，不是体系本身。

entries.definition: The rules and assessments that regulate fishing; it is one part of fisheries, not the whole sector.
entries.definitionCN: 规范捕捞的规则与评估；它是渔业的一部分，不是整个行业。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real suffix history, real sector categories and real management collocations.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实后缀历史、真实行业类别与真实管理搭配。

normal.en: Fish plus -ery makes fishery, a place and practice of catching fish.
normal.cn: fish 加 -ery 构成 fishery，即捕鱼的地点与行业。

normal.en: Fisheries is simply the plural, but it often names the whole sector.
normal.cn: fisheries 只是复数，却常指整个行业。

normal.en: Marine and inland are the two great divisions.
normal.cn: 海洋与内陆是两大分区。

normal.en: Fisheries science sets limits; fisheries policy enforces them.
normal.cn: 渔业科学设上限，渔业政策执行上限。

normal.en: The broad sector now includes aquaculture as well as capture.
normal.cn: 宽口径行业如今既含捕捞也含养殖。

abstract.en: Picture a harbour before dawn, every boat carrying a share of one shared stock.
abstract.cn: 想象黎明前的港口，每条船都载着同一份共享资源的一部分。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger where catches, limits and licenses are written on the same page.
abstract.cn: 想象一本账，渔获、上限与许可证写在同一页。

abstract.en: Picture a single fish counted by a scientist, a boat and a treaty at once.
abstract.cn: 想象同一条鱼同时被科学家、渔船与条约计算。

examples.en: Small-scale fisheries employ most of the region's coastal workers.
examples.cn: 小规模渔业雇用了该区域大部分沿海劳动者。

examples.en: Fisheries and conservation groups negotiated the closed season.
examples.cn: 渔业与保护团体谈判确定了禁渔期。

examples.en: Inland fisheries collapsed after the dam blocked the migration.
examples.cn: 水坝阻断洄游后，内陆渔业崩溃。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「fish（鱼）+ -ery（行业/场所）+ 复数」——捕鱼的行业与渔场 → 渔业

root: fish 出自古英语 fisc，属日耳曼语 *fiskaz（重构形式），与拉丁 piscis 同源；后缀 -ery 经古法语 -erie 来自拉丁 -aria，表示地点或行业；fishery 加复数 -ies 成 fisheries，现代常指整个渔业部门。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one industry: the sector, the grounds, the fleets, the stocks, the wider scope, inland fisheries, management and access rights.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一行业展开：产业、渔场、船队、资源、宽口径、内陆渔业、管理与渔业权。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a harbour at dawn, boats side by side, iced fish on the quay and an auction board turning.
core.cn: 核心意象：黎明时的港口，渔船并排，码头冰面上摊着鱼，拍卖牌不停翻动。

branches.en: SECTOR TO PLACE: an industry is also a set of named grounds on the water.
branches.cn: 从行业到地点：一个产业同时也是一片片具名水域。

branches.en: GEAR TO RESOURCE: boats and gear exist only because there is a stock to harvest.
branches.cn: 从渔具到资源：船与网存在，只因为有可收获取的资源。

branches.en: THE INLAND WATERS: the same harvest logic applies in rivers and lakes.
branches.cn: 内陆水域：同一套收获逻辑也适用于河流与湖泊。

branches.en: THE WIDER SECTOR: once aquaculture is counted, one word covers both.
branches.cn: 行业口径：一旦算入养殖，一个词就覆盖两者。

branches.en: MANAGEMENT TO RIGHTS: rules decide who may fish, and those permissions become property.
branches.cn: 从管理到权利：规则决定谁能捕鱼，这些许可随后成为财产。

intro.en: Fisheries is a plural noun whose base fishery is a transparent native root plus a borrowed suffix; the plural adds no new meaning beyond number.
intro.cn: fisheries 是复数名词，其基础 fishery 由本族词根加借入后缀透明构成；复数除数量外不添加新义。

latinIntro.en: The suffix -ery reaches Latin -aria through French, while fish itself is Germanic; only piscis is a distant Latin relative.
latinIntro.cn: 后缀 -ery 经法语上溯拉丁 -aria，而 fish 本身属日耳曼语；只有 piscis 是拉丁远亲。

items.example: The fish return to the river each year.
The suffix builds words like bakery and fishery.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成 bakery 与 fishery 一类词。
资源恢复后渔场重新开放。

items.example: The fisher mended the net at dawn.
The fisherman knew the tide by memory.
items.exampleCN: 这位渔民凭记忆就知道潮汐。
渔业管理使用资源评估。

items.example: Aquaculture now exceeds capture in some markets.
items.exampleCN: 在某些市场，养殖已超过捕捞。

items.meaning: the scientific estimate of a fish population
items.example: The stock assessment set the catch limit.
items.exampleCN: 资源评估设定了捕捞上限。

definition_zh: n. 承包商，承包人
definition_en: a person or firm hired to do work under a contract
core_image: 戴安全帽的人拿着图纸站在脚手架下
scene: 承包商答应在雨季前修好屋顶。 The contractor promised to fix the roof before the rains.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：contractor 指承包商；句意是承包商答应雨季前修好屋顶。

pos.zh: 承包商；签约方

senses.title: A building contractor
senses.definition: a firm paid to build or repair things
senses.definitionCN: 承接建造或维修的工程公司
senses.example: The contractor rebuilt the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 承包商重建了厨房。
senses.why: A hard hat among scaffolding.
senses.whyCN: 脚手架下的一顶安全帽。

senses.title: A party to a contract
senses.definition: a person or company bound by a contract
senses.definitionCN: 受合同约束的个人或公司
senses.example: Both contractors signed the deal.
senses.exampleCN: 签约双方都在合同上签了字。
senses.why: A signature ties two sides together.
senses.whyCN: 一个签名把两方绑在一起。

senses.title: A government contractor
senses.definition: a firm that supplies the state
senses.definitionCN: 向政府供货或服务的公司
senses.example: The government contractor delivered trucks.
senses.exampleCN: 政府承包商交付了卡车。
senses.why: Public money buys private work.
senses.whyCN: 公款购买私营的服务。

intro.en: Contractor adds -or to contract, from Latin contrahere, to draw together.
intro.cn: contractor 在 contract 后加 -or；contract 源自拉丁语 contrahere，意为拉拢在一起。

items.en: Trahere means to draw or pull.
items.cn: trahere 意为拉、拖。

items.en: Contrahere means to draw together, to make a bargain.
items.cn: contrahere 意为拉到一起，即订约。

items.en: Contractus means a drawn-up agreement.
items.cn: contractus 意为订立的契约。

items.en: English named the party a contractor.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语把签约一方称作 contractor。

items.en: Trade law fixed the builder sense.
items.cn: 十八世纪商法确立了「建筑承包商」之义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the contract- stem; the near-meaning group names who does the work.
note.cn: 形近组共享 contract- 词干；近义组都是「承接工作的人」。

entries.definition: A binding written deal.
entries.definitionCN: 有约束力的合同。

entries.definition: The act of becoming smaller.
entries.definitionCN: 收缩。

entries.definition: Communication or physical touch.
entries.definitionCN: 接触。

entries.definition: A person or firm that builds.
entries.definitionCN: 建造者。

entries.definition: A firm that provides goods.
entries.definitionCN: 供应商。

entries.definition: A seller of goods or services.
entries.definitionCN: 卖方。

entries.definition: A business organization.
entries.definitionCN: 公司。

normalIntro.en: A contractor is a signature plus a hard hat.
normalIntro.cn: contractor 就是一个签名加一顶安全帽。

normal.en: Contrahere means to draw a bargain together.
normal.cn: contrahere 意为把交易拉拢到一起。

normal.en: -or names the one who holds the contract.
normal.cn: -or 指持有合同的一方。

normal.en: The contractor promised the roof by the rains.
normal.cn: 承包商答应雨季前修好屋顶。

normal.en: An independent contractor works on their own.
normal.cn: 独立承包人自己接活。

normal.en: A government contractor supplies the state.
normal.cn: 政府承包商为政府供货。

abstract.en: A hard hat under scaffolding.
abstract.cn: 脚手架下的一顶安全帽。

abstract.en: A contract with a signature line.
abstract.cn: 带签名栏的合同。

abstract.en: A lorry delivering on a schedule.
abstract.cn: 按工期送货的卡车。

examples.en: The contractor finished the roof early.
examples.cn: 承包商提前修好了屋顶。

examples.en: We hired an independent contractor.
examples.cn: 我们雇了一位独立承包人。

examples.en: The government contractor won the bid.
examples.cn: 政府承包商中标了。

dict_mnemonic.text: contract（合同）+ or（人／方）→ 按合同接活的一方，即承包商。

root: 拉丁 con（一起）+ trahere（拉）+ -tus + 英语 -or → 英语 contractor

sensesIntro.en: Whoever signs to do the work, from builder to supplier.
sensesIntro.cn: 从施工到供货，凡是签约干活的一方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hard hat beside a signed contract
core.cn: 核心意象：安全帽旁的签约合同

branches.en: A firm that rebuilds a kitchen.
branches.cn: 重建厨房的公司。

branches.en: Two sides bound by a signature.
branches.cn: 以签名相互约束的两方。

branches.en: A firm paid by the state.
branches.cn: 由州政府付钱的公司。

branches.en: Work bought with public money.
branches.cn: 用公款买来的工程。

branches.en: A deal that must be delivered.
branches.cn: 必须兑现的约定。

intro.en: Contractor puts the agent suffix -or on contract, from contrahere.
intro.cn: contractor 在 contract 上加表施动者的后缀 -or，源出 contrahere。

latinIntro.en: Latin contrahere means to draw together and to strike a bargain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 contrahere 意为拉到一起、订立契约。

definition_zh: 化学上；用化学方法；在化学性质上；由化学作用造成地
definition_en: in chemical terms, by chemical means, or with respect to chemical properties
core_image: 试纸浸入液面的一瞬由蓝转红，操作者把两张记录纸并排放好，比对颜色深浅
scene: 试纸浸入液面的一瞬由蓝转红，操作者把两张记录纸并排放好，比对颜色深浅。 The two samples differ chemically even though they look identical.
sceneCN: 这里 chemically 指在化学性质上（第 4 个义项：就化学组成与性质而言）；句意：两个样品外观完全相同，化学性质却不同。图中可辨识物件：试纸、两支试管、比色卡、记录纸。

pos.zh: 化学上；用化学方法；在化学性质方面

senses.title: In chemical terms
senses.definition: considered from the point of view of chemistry rather than of physics, biology or everyday description
senses.definitionCN: 从化学而非物理、生物或日常描述的角度来看
senses.example: Chemically, the alloy is mostly iron with a little carbon.
senses.exampleCN: 从化学上看，这种合金主要是铁，外加少量碳。
senses.why: the adverb opens a sentence the way a field label does, telling the reader which description is being used.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词像领域标签一样开启句子，告诉读者正在使用哪一种描述方式。

senses.title: By chemical means
senses.definition: by a process that uses chemical agents rather than mechanical or physical ones
senses.definitionCN: 通过使用化学试剂而非机械或物理手段的工序
senses.example: The surface was chemically polished before the paint went on.
senses.exampleCN: 上漆之前，表面先用化学方法抛光。
senses.why: here the adverb answers how something is done, and the answer is a reaction rather than a tool.
senses.whyCN: 这里的副词回答「怎么做」，而答案是反应，不是工具。

senses.title: By artificial synthesis
senses.definition: made in a laboratory or factory rather than taken directly from a living source
senses.definitionCN: 在实验室或工厂制成，而非直接取自生物来源
senses.example: Most of the vitamin C in the bottle was chemically synthesized.
senses.exampleCN: 瓶中的维生素 C 大多是化学合成的。
senses.why: since laboratory production is almost always chemical, the adverb became a short way of saying made rather than grown.
senses.whyCN: 由于实验室生产几乎总是化学的，这个副词就成了「是造出来的，不是长出来的」的简写。

senses.title: In chemical properties
senses.definition: with respect to composition and behaviour in reactions, as opposed to appearance
senses.definitionCN: 就组成与反应中的行为而言，与外观相对
senses.example: The two samples differ chemically even though they look identical.
senses.exampleCN: 两个样品外观完全相同，化学性质却不同。
senses.why: when two things look alike but behave differently, the adverb marks the hidden dimension in which they actually differ.
senses.whyCN: 当两件东西样子相同而表现不同时，这个副词标出它们真正有差别的那个看不见的维度。

senses.title: Caused by a chemical
senses.definition: brought about by exposure to a chemical substance, as a rash, a burn or a change in the body
senses.definitionCN: 因接触化学物质而产生，如皮疹、灼伤或体内变化
senses.example: The rash was chemically induced, not infectious.
senses.exampleCN: 这皮疹是化学物质引起的，不是传染性的。
senses.why: the adverb plus a participle names the cause, separating a reaction to a substance from a reaction to a germ.
senses.whyCN: 副词加过去分词指明原因，把对物质的反应与对病菌的反应区分开。

senses.title: In chemical structure
senses.definition: with respect to the arrangement of atoms or the identity of a molecular family
senses.definitionCN: 就原子排列或分子所属类别而言
senses.example: The two hormones are chemically related but act on different tissues.
senses.exampleCN: 这两种激素在化学结构上同族，却作用于不同组织。
senses.why: the adverb marks kinship at the level of structure rather than of function.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词标记的是结构层面的亲缘关系，而不是功能层面。

senses.title: Inside the body's chemistry
senses.definition: with respect to the chemical processes of a living body, as in chemically altered metabolism
senses.definitionCN: 就生物体内化学过程而言，如被化学改变的代谢
senses.example: The drug chemically alters the way the liver processes fat.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药在化学层面改变了肝脏处理脂肪的方式。
senses.why: medicine describes what a substance does inside the body as a chemical change, so the adverb marks that inner level.
senses.whyCN: 医学把某种物质在体内做的事描述为化学变化，这个副词便标记那个内部层面。

senses.title: As a field label in speech
senses.definition: used at the start of a remark to signal that the following statement belongs to chemistry
senses.definitionCN: 置于话语开头，提示随后的话属于化学领域
senses.example: Chemically speaking, the two salts belong to the same family.
senses.exampleCN: 从化学角度说，这两种盐属于同一族。
senses.why: speakers borrow the adverb to frame a claim, exactly as they say legally speaking or medically speaking.
senses.whyCN: 说话人借这个副词来框定一句话，正如说「从法律上说」「从医学上说」。

intro.en: Chemically is the adverb of chemical, which comes from Medieval Latin chymicus, itself built on alchimia, the alchemy word. The adverb ending is English. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: chemically 是 chemical 的副词形式；chemical 出自中世纪拉丁语 chymicus，后者又由 alchimia（炼金术一词）构成。副词词尾来自英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Chymicus, also written alchimicus, meant of the chemical art and described both substances and practitioners in medieval texts.
items.cn: chymicus 也写作 alchimicus，意为「属于化学技艺的」，在中世纪文本中既形容物质，也形容从业者。

items.en: English chemical appears in the seventeenth century, replacing the older chymical, and serves as both adjective and noun.
items.cn: 英语 chemical 出现于 17 世纪，取代更早的 chymical，既作形容词也作名词。

items.en: The ending -ly descends from Old English -līce and turns an adjective into an adverb of manner or viewpoint.
items.cn: 词尾 -ly 出自古英语 -līce，把形容词变成表示方式或视角的副词。

items.en: Chemically is recorded in English from the seventeenth century, first in the sense of by chemical means.
items.cn: chemically 在英语中自 17 世纪有记录，最初意为「用化学方法」。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): beyond chymicus the trail enters the disputed pre-Greek history of alchemy, and the earliest use of the adverb is not precisely dated, so both the date and the deeper chain are approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深源头与首见年代）：越过 chymicus 之后，线索进入炼金术那个有争议的希腊语之前的历史；这个副词的最早用例也没有确切年代，因此年代与更深源流都只是约数。

note.en: The first group is the same stem in other shapes; the second group is adverbs that label a different viewpoint or a different way of making something.
note.cn: 第一组是同一词干的其他形态；第二组是标记别的视角、或别的制作方式的副词。

entries.definition: The adjective behind the adverb; it describes a noun, whereas the adverb describes how or in what respect.
entries.definitionCN: 副词背后的形容词，修饰名词；副词则说明方式或视角。

entries.definition: The name of the science; it cannot stand where the adverb stands.
entries.definitionCN: 学科名称，不能出现在副词的位置。

entries.definition: The person, not the manner; the pair differ by their endings alone.
entries.definitionCN: 指人而非方式；两者只差词尾。

entries.definition: The adjective of the older art, still used for symbolic or archaic contexts rather than for laboratory work.
entries.definitionCN: 更古老技艺的形容词，仍用于象征性或古旧语境，而非实验室工作。

entries.definition: In terms of physics or the body; it contrasts with chemically when a change is described at the level of atoms versus at the level of matter in bulk.
entries.definitionCN: 从物理或身体角度；当变化分别从原子层面与宏观物质层面描述时，它与 chemically 相对。

entries.definition: In terms of living processes; a substance may be chemically inert yet biologically active.
entries.definitionCN: 从生命过程角度；一种物质可能在化学上不活泼，却在生物上有作用。

entries.definition: By building a substance from simpler parts in a laboratory, a sense chemically can carry but does not always.
entries.definitionCN: 在实验室里由更简单的部分造出物质，chemically 有时含此义，但并不总是。

entries.definition: By human action rather than nature; it says nothing about the method, which chemically may specify.
entries.definitionCN: 指非自然、由人力造成；它不说明方法，而 chemically 可能指明方法。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin stem, the real adverb ending and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁词干、真实的副词词尾与真实的固定搭配。

normal.en: Chemical plus the adverb ending -ly gives the word, and the ending answers the question how or in what respect.
normal.cn: chemical 加副词词尾 -ly 构成这个词，词尾回答「如何」或「在哪个方面」。

normal.en: The family runs chemical, chemically, chemistry, chemist and alchemical.
normal.cn: 同族词有 chemical、chemically、chemistry、chemist 与 alchemical。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the range: chemically identical, chemically inert, chemically pure.
normal.cn: 固定搭配显示范围：化学上相同、化学上不活泼、化学纯。

normal.en: The word sits beside physically and biologically as a viewpoint label.
normal.cn: 这个词与 physically、biologically 并列，都是视角标签。

normal.en: A strange ad says no chemicals, yet the product is chemically identical to the natural one.
normal.cn: 一句奇怪的广告说「不含化学物质」，可产品与天然品在化学上完全相同。

abstract.en: Picture two keys cut from the same blank that open different doors.
abstract.cn: 想象两把从同一块坯料切出的钥匙，却打开不同的门。

abstract.en: Picture a label on a bottle that describes behaviour instead of appearance.
abstract.cn: 想象瓶子上的一张标签，描述的是行为而不是外观。

abstract.en: Picture a translator who explains a taste by naming the ingredients.
abstract.cn: 想象一位译者，用列出配料来解释一种味道。

examples.en: Chemically, the human body is mostly water.
examples.cn: 从化学上看，人体主要由水构成。

examples.en: The pipes were chemically cleaned instead of replaced.
examples.cn: 管道是用化学方法清洗的，而非更换。

examples.en: Chemically speaking, graphite and diamond are the same element.
examples.cn: 从化学角度说，石墨与金刚石是同一种元素。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「化学（chemical）+ 地（-ly）」——以化学的方式 → 化学上、用化学方法

root: 中世纪拉丁 chymicus「属于化学技艺的」→ 英语 chemical「化学的」→ 加副词词尾 -ly → chemically；更深源头通向阿拉伯语炼金术名称，希腊语之前的来源无定论。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one question: in what respect, or by what means, is something being described as chemical? The answer runs from a viewpoint label to a method, a manufacture, a property, a cause, a structure, an inner process and finally a phrase that frames a claim.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个问题展开：究竟在哪个方面、用什么手段，把某事说成「化学的」？答案从视角标签延伸到方法、制造、性质、成因、结构、体内过程，最后是一个框定话语的说法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a strip of test paper crossing a liquid surface and changing colour at the moment of contact.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条试纸越过液面，在接触的一瞬变色。

branches.en: FRAMING: the word tells the listener which description is in force, in writing or in speech.
branches.cn: 框定：这个词告诉听者，此刻生效的是哪一种描述，书面与口语皆然。

branches.en: METHOD: a reaction does the work that a tool would otherwise do.
branches.cn: 方法：让反应来完成本该由工具完成的活。

branches.en: MANUFACTURE: what is made in a plant rather than grown.
branches.cn: 制造：在工厂里造出来，而不是长出来。

branches.en: HIDDEN DIMENSION: two things alike in appearance but different in makeup, or related in structure.
branches.cn: 看不见的维度：外观相同而组成不同，或在结构上同族。

branches.en: INNER CAUSE: a substance acting on a surface or inside a living body.
branches.cn: 内部成因：物质作用于表面，或作用于活体内部。

intro.en: Chemically is the shortest word in the family to show all three layers at once: a borrowed stem, an adjective ending and an adverb ending.
intro.cn: chemically 是这个词族中能一次显示三层结构的最短词：借入词干、形容词词尾、副词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Medieval Latin chymicus and alchimia supply the stem and the adjective pattern; the adverb ending itself is English, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 chymicus 与 alchimia 提供词干与形容词样板；副词词尾本身来自英语，不是拉丁语。

items.example: The stem is shared by the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干由整个词族共用。

items.example: The ending makes an adjective of the stem.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把词干变成形容词。

items.meaning: in a given manner or respect
items.meaningCN: 以某种方式或在某方面
items.example: The ending turns the adjective into a manner word.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把形容词变成方式副词。

items.meaning: in chemical terms or by chemical means
items.meaningCN: 从化学角度；用化学方法
items.exampleCN: 两个样品在化学上不同。

items.meaningCN: 属于更古老变金技艺的
items.example: Alchemical symbols fill the old manuscript.
items.exampleCN: 古老手稿里满是炼金术符号。

items.meaning: in terms of the chemistry of life
items.example: The two patients are biochemically similar.
items.exampleCN: 两位病人在生物化学上相似。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 化学的；属于化学技艺的
